The Sun sends the Moon a friendly wave this afternoon.

The Moon in Capricorn gets a friendly sextile from the Sun and a tense square to Venus, both this afternoon. Swipe for Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Fire friend. 🌙
